specs.power: USB rechargeable or two 1.5V AAA batteries

record.description: A stainless steel and white digital kitchen scale from Kiaitre that weighs up to 5000 g (about 11 lb) in 1 g steps. It has a tare function for subtracting container weight and switches between g, kg, lb, oz and ml. Rechargeable by USB or powered by two AAA batteries, which are included.
record.long_description:
The Kiaitre Digital Food Scale brings a clean, modern look to the kitchen with its stainless steel and white body and brushed stainless platform. It weighs ingredients up to 5000 grams, about 11 pounds, and reads in steps of 1 gram or 0.04 ounces, so you can measure flour, sugar, or liquids for cooking and baking.

The tare button lets you zero out the weight of a bowl or container, so you can add ingredients one after another and see only what each one weighs. A single unit button switches the large LCD display between grams, kilograms, pounds, ounces, and milliliters, which helps when a recipe uses measurements you are not used to.

The scale is compact and light, so it fits easily on a counter or in a drawer. Wiping the platform with a damp cloth is usually enough to clean it. For the most reliable readings, place it on a flat, level surface.

Power comes from a USB rechargeable battery or two 1.5V AAA batteries, and both options are included. The display shows a low battery warning and an overload warning, and the scale turns itself off after three minutes of inactivity to save power.
record.meta_description: Kiaitre digital kitchen scale with 5000 g capacity, 1 g precision, tare function and USB or AAA battery power. Weighs in g, kg, lb, oz and ml.
record.seo_title: Kiaitre Digital Food Scale, USB Rechargeable Kitchen Scale

record.description: Automatic table tennis training robot from ZXMOTO that fires 40mm international standard balls at adjustable frequency and spin. Includes a catch net and a hopper holding about 120 balls.
record.long_description:
The ZXMOTO Table Tennis Robot is an automatic ping pong machine built for solo practice. It feeds 40mm (1.57 inch) international standard balls, and its ball container holds about 120 balls, so you can keep rallying without stopping to collect them. A catch net is included to gather the balls after they are returned.

You can change the machine's frequency to suit the pace you want to practice, and adjust the spin setting to match the kind of return you want to handle. Both settings are controlled with buttons on the unit, so you can tune the drills as your skills develop. The machine's position can also be adjusted to your preferences, letting you set up the feed angle that works best for your space and style.

The robot is suited to players who want repeatable practice sessions for serves, returns, and spin work without needing a partner. Use the international standard 40mm balls specified for the machine, as other sizes may not feed correctly. Setup is simple: fill the hopper, choose your frequency and spin, position the robot, and start training.
record.meta_description: Train solo with the ZXMOTO automatic ping pong robot. Adjustable frequency and spin, a catch net, and a ball hopper holding about 120 balls.
record.seo_title: ZXMOTO Table Tennis Robot with Catch Net for Training

specs.chamber design: Swirling airflow to reduce unpopped kernels

record.description: Red Nostalgia OFP-501 old fashioned popcorn machine that uses hot air instead of oil to pop up to 12 cups per batch. Rated 1040 W at 120 V, it includes a kernel measuring cap and a swirling airflow chamber meant to reduce unpopped kernels.
record.long_description:
The Nostalgia OFP-501 brings the classic movie-night popcorn machine home in a bright red finish. It uses hot air rather than oil to pop kernels, so you get an oil-free snack without the added fat. Each batch can yield up to 12 cups, which is plenty for a family movie night, a game day gathering, or a quick afternoon treat.

The popping chamber is designed to create a swirling airflow that helps move kernels around as they pop, which the manufacturer says leads to fewer unpopped kernels. A measuring cap is included so you can portion the right amount of kernels for every batch, taking the guesswork out of each round.

Rated at 1040 watts and 120 volts, the unit is designed for standard household power. It pairs with other Nostalgia accessories, including the theater hot air popcorn kit (KPK400) and the reusable popcorn bowls (PPB600), so you can serve your popcorn in a consistent, familiar setup.

Whether you are popping for kids after school or setting up a snack station for guests, this machine offers a simple, oil-free way to make theater-style popcorn at home.
record.meta_description: Pop up to 12 cups of oil-free popcorn per batch with the red Nostalgia OFP-501. Hot air popping, 1040 W, 120 V, and a kernel measuring cap included.
record.seo_title: Nostalgia OFP-501 Hot Air Popcorn Machine, 12 Cup Red

specs.braking: Electric brake stops blade on trigger release

record.description: A cordless 7-1/4-inch circular saw from DEWALT's FLEXVOLT ADVANTAGE line, running on 20V MAX power and compatible with FLEXVOLT batteries. It ships as a tool only, with no battery or charger. A brushless motor turns the blade at 5,500 RPM, and an electric brake stops it when the trigger is released.
record.long_description: The DEWALT DCS573B is a cordless 7-1/4-inch circular saw from the FLEXVOLT ADVANTAGE line, built on 20V MAX power and compatible with FLEXVOLT batteries. It is sold as a tool only, so batteries and a charger are purchased separately. The brushless motor drives the blade at 5,500 RPM, which the manufacturer links to faster cutting. When paired with FLEXVOLT batteries, DEWALT states the saw delivers up to 77% more power. At a 90-degree bevel, the saw cuts to a maximum depth of 2-9/16 inches. At a 45-degree bevel, the maximum depth is 2 inches. An electric brake stops the blade shortly after the trigger is released, which helps you move on to the next cut or set the saw down sooner. The compact body is intended for cutting lumber and other common building materials on job sites and in home workshops. Confirm battery and charger compatibility before ordering, since the saw does not include power accessories.
record.meta_description: Cordless DEWALT 20V MAX FLEXVOLT 7-1/4-inch circular saw, tool only. Brushless motor, 5,500 RPM, electric brake, 2-9/16-inch depth at 90 degrees.

record.description: The Pool Blaster Aqua Broom is a lightweight cordless vacuum for cleaning sand, silt and dirt in spas, small pools and tight spaces. It runs up to three hours on five D-cell batteries, works by hand or on a standard telescopic pole, and weighs under 2 lbs.
record.long_description: The Pool Blaster Aqua Broom is a cordless vacuum built for cleaning sand, silt and dirt in spas, hot tubs, small pools and tight spaces. It is listed for inground, above-ground and inflatable pools. Because it runs on batteries, it needs no hose, pump or water hookup, and you switch it on with a simple twist. The unit runs for up to three hours on five D-cell batteries and is designed for more intense particulate cleaning than many vacuums for these pools. Weighing less than two pounds, it can be used by hand or fitted to any standard telescopic pool pole through the included adapter. The pole itself is sold separately. A patented Retention Valve is meant to keep debris from returning to the water. The kit includes one all-purpose filter bag and disposable micro-filter bags to catch fine material. Its focus on sand, silt and dirt makes it suited to spas and smaller pools where those materials tend to build up.
record.meta_description: Cordless battery-powered vacuum for spas, small pools and tight spaces. Runs up to 3 hours on five D-cell batteries and picks up sand and silt with ease.

record.description: A GPS bike computer in stealth black that builds and follows routes with on-screen pop-up and LED turn-by-turn alerts. record.long_description: The Wahoo ELEMNT Bolt is a GPS bike computer built for riders who want clear navigation and simple setup. The free ELEMNT Companion App handles pairing and configuration, so you can move from unboxing to riding without much fuss. Once a route is built, the unit shows pop-up alerts on screen and flashes LED turn-by-turn cues, helping you keep track of where to go. Routes can be downloaded and uploaded automatically with several third-party services, including Strava, Ride With GPS, Best Bike Split, Komoot, Singletracks and MTB Project. Integration with Strava Live Segments provides progress updates along the way and a final push to help you reach your goals. The unit receives signals from GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo and QZSS satellite systems. Its battery is rated for about 15 hours of use, and the IPX7 rating means it is waterproof to a depth of around five feet, so it can handle rain and splashes. The box includes the ELEMNT Bolt, an integrated aero out-front mount, a stem mount and a charging cable, giving you two mounting options out of the box. The stealth black finish keeps the computer understated on any bike.
record.meta_description: Wahoo ELEMNT Bolt GPS bike computer in stealth black with turn-by-turn alerts, 15-hour battery, IPX7 water resistance and Strava route sync.

record.description: A 50-foot brown RG-316 coaxial cable with a 50-ohm impedance and a thin 0.1-inch diameter. record.long_description: The XRDS-RF RG-316 is a 50-foot length of miniature coaxial cable built for projects where space and flexibility matter. The 50-ohm cable has a stranded core with silver-plated copper conductors, including a silver-plated copper braid, which is intended to keep signal loss low. The PTFE (Teflon) jacket is designed to handle demanding conditions, including outdoor use. The cable is rated for frequencies up to 6 GHz and an operating range of -55 to +200 °C. Its minimum installation bend radius is 0.53 inch, and its maximum tensile strength is listed at 12.2 lb. Common uses include antenna cable assemblies, where SMA connectors can be crimped on, as well as baluns, coax capacitors, and interconnects for VHF, UHF, ham radio, 4G LTE, ADS-B, and Wi-Fi equipment. Because it is lightweight and easy to handle, it suits both bench projects and permanent installations. Each package includes one 50-foot cable.

record.description: A USB condenser microphone kit from MAONO with a cardioid pickup pattern, 192kHz/24-bit sampling and a 16mm electret capsule. It plugs into a computer over USB 2.0 without extra drivers or a sound card, and includes a boom arm, pop filter, foam windscreen and shock mount for recording, streaming and voice work.
record.long_description:
The MAONO AU-A04 is a USB condenser microphone kit for creators who want clear vocals without a separate audio interface. It samples at up to 192kHz/24-bit and is rated for a frequency response of 30Hz to 16kHz, a range that suits singing, speech and voiceover work. A cardioid pickup pattern concentrates on sound directly in front of the capsule, which helps reduce pickup from the sides and rear.

The unit runs on 110-240 V AC, 50-60 Hz, drawing 8 watts. The 5,000 square foot figure is a maximum, so real results depend on your building layout and outdoor signal strength.

specs.compatible models: SS3 and SS5 single stage reciprocating compressors

record.description: A replacement pressure switch for Ingersoll-Rand SS3 and SS5 single stage reciprocating air compressors. It cuts in at 100 psig and cuts out at 135 psig, housed in a NEMA type 1 enclosure.
record.long_description:
The Ingersoll-Rand 23474661 pressure switch is made for the SS3 and SS5 single stage reciprocating air compressors. It manages the compressor's operating pressure by starting the motor when tank pressure drops to 100 psig and stopping it once the pressure reaches 135 psig. Those fixed set points keep the tank within a defined pressure range during normal operation.

The switch sits in a NEMA type 1 enclosure, which protects its internal components from accidental contact and falling dirt. Its specifications are straightforward: a 100 psig cut-in point and a 135 psig cut-out point, matching the operating range these compressor models are designed to use.

This part is a good fit for anyone who needs to replace a worn or failed switch on an SS3 or SS5 compressor and wants the original Ingersoll-Rand part number. Before ordering, confirm your compressor model and the existing switch's part number, since the listing identifies compatibility only with the SS3 and SS5 single stage units.
record.meta_description: Replacement Ingersoll-Rand 23474661 pressure switch for SS3 and SS5 single stage compressors. 100 psig cut-in, 135 psig cut-out, NEMA type 1 enclosure.
record.seo_title: Ingersoll-Rand 23474661 Pressure Switch, SS3 SS5

record.description: A 3.5-quart digital hot air fryer from Elite Gourmet with 1400W power and six cooking functions for frying, baking, grilling, and roasting. It has a PFOA/PTFE free non-stick basket, a 149 to 400°F range, and a 60-minute auto shut-off timer.
record.long_description:
The Elite Gourmet EAF-1506D is a 3.5-quart digital hot air fryer designed for family-sized meals. Its PFOA and PTFE free non-stick basket holds up to 2.5 pounds of food, so you can prepare a good amount in one batch.

Powered by 1400W, a high-power convection fan circulates heat around your food across a temperature range of 149 to 400°F. Six menu functions let you fry, bake, grill, roast and more from a single unit, and the 60-minute timer shuts the fryer off automatically when the cooking cycle ends.

The fryer is intended for cooking with much less oil than deep frying, which suits lighter everyday meals. You can add a tablespoon of oil if you want extra crispness. It works well for veggie chips, fish fillets, chicken tenders and other favorites. A full-color booklet with 26 recipes is included to help you get started.

A cool-touch handle makes it easier to lift out fried foods without burning your hands. The black exterior can be kept clean by wiping it with a damp cloth.
record.meta_description: Elite Gourmet 3.5-quart digital hot air fryer with 1400W power, six cooking functions, 149–400°F range, and a 60-minute auto shut-off timer.

record.description: Kohler Forte wall-mount showerhead in polished chrome with Katalyst air induction spray. Delivers 2.5 GPM in a single spray function, with a master clean face that resists hard water buildup and is easy to clean.
record.long_description:
The Kohler Forte wall-mount showerhead uses Katalyst air induction spray technology with a single spray function. Air is mixed into the water flow, which Kohler describes as a way to create a fuller, more even spray. The water is delivered as larger, fuller drops that stay close to the body rather than scattering away from it.

This showerhead has a flow rate of 2.5 gallons per minute and mounts to the wall, so it fits a standard shower arm installation. Its polished chrome finish complements many bathroom fixtures and hardware.

The master clean spray face is designed to resist hard water buildup, which helps the nozzle face stay clearer between cleanings. When residue does build up, the face is simple to wipe clean.

Model K-10282-AK-CP from Kohler is an option for anyone looking to refresh a shower with an even, air-infused spray that is easy to maintain.
record.meta_description: Kohler Forte 2.5 GPM wall-mount showerhead in polished chrome with Katalyst air induction spray. Master clean face resists hard water buildup.

Padded cushioning at the heel and Achilles area adds everyday comfort, making them a practical choice for extended travel days, long flights, or a full shift at a desk or on your feet. The anatomical fit is shaped to follow the leg, so the compression stays where it is meant to work.

The sock is knitted from an 85% polyamide (nylon) and 15% elastane blend. Its synthetic fibers are lightweight and breathable, helping skin stay dry and comfortable through the day. Wear them after training to aid recovery, or during travel and periods of inactivity when you want extra leg support. CEP's medical heritage informs the fit and construction, aiming for a sock that stays in place and is built to last through repeated wear.

The semi-gloss sheen offers a finish that sits between flat and high-gloss, giving a surface some shine without a mirror-like reflection. Check the product packaging and current documentation for surface compatibility, application instructions, and safety details before use.
record.meta_description: Bona Mega semi-gloss floor finish in 1 gallon, covering 500 to 600 sq. ft. with a 2 to 3 hour dry time. GREENGUARD certified and made in Sweden.

record.description: A wearable posture corrector for women and children that uses a built-in sensor to detect slouching and gives a vibration reminder to sit or stand straighter. Features an LED display, rechargeable battery, and adjustable soft nylon harness for users 15 to 100 kg.

The rechargeable 500mAh, 3.7V battery charges through a standard V8 USB port in about two hours and draws 0.4W. The unit weighs 85g and is rated for users from 15 kg to 100 kg. Hold the switch for one second to power it on. The package includes the corrector and a USB charging cable.

record.description: A 24.5-inch Full HD LED monitor from Acer with a 16:9 TN film panel, 1 ms GTG response time and 144 Hz refresh rate. It supports AMD FreeSync to reduce screen tearing and includes HDMI and DisplayPort inputs plus built-in speakers.
record.long_description:
The Acer XF250Q is a 24.5-inch widescreen LED monitor built for smooth, responsive viewing. Its 16:9 Full HD panel shows 1920 x 1080 resolution and uses twisted nematic film technology with a 1 ms GTG response time and a standard 144 Hz refresh rate, which suits fast-moving on-screen action.

AMD FreeSync works by matching the display's refresh rate to the frames sent by your graphics card. That helps reduce screen tearing and stuttering during play. The monitor is rated at 400 nits of brightness with a 1,000:1 contrast ratio and displays 16.7 million colors at 8-bit color depth.

Viewing angles are rated at 170 degrees horizontally and 160 degrees vertically. The stand offers tilt from -5 to 35 degrees, swivel of plus or minus 60 degrees, and adjustable pivot, so you can position the screen to suit your desk.

Connectivity includes two HDMI 1.4 inputs and one DisplayPort. Two built-in 2 W speakers provide basic audio. The listing advertises a free three-year warranty.

This two-layer hammock is finished in grey and features a cat-face metal frame that is sturdy and attractive. It attaches to a window with suction cups, and the manufacturer rates it to hold up to 55 lb. The two levels give your cat room to lounge on the upper layer while standing or climbing on the lower one. The sandwiching height can be adjusted among 11, 11.8, 12.6 and 13.4 inches, so the fit can suit cats of different sizes. The plush mattress comes off for cleaning and is machine washable. Installation requires a glass window at least 17.7 inches wide. The listing advises that windows narrower than about 21 inches need extra checking, and that the hammock may not fit if the window frame stands more than about 0.3 inches proud of the glass. Measure your window before ordering. The product carries a 12-month warranty covering the hammock and its accessories. Suction cups should be tightened gently, since overtightening can crack the plastic covers.
record.meta_description: Grey LIFIS cat window perch with two levels, suction cups rated to 55 lb, a metal cat-face frame and a removable washable plush mattress.
record.seo_title: LIFIS Grey Cat Window Perch, 2-Layer Cat Hammock

record.description: Dove-colored linen blend curtain panels with an open weave and nickel grommet tops. Each panel measures 52 by 84 inches. The set of two lets diffused light into the room while adding privacy and a relaxed, natural look.
record.long_description:
Bring a relaxed, natural look to your windows with this pair of dove-colored curtain panels from H.VERSAILTEX. Each panel is woven from an open-weave linen blend that gives the fabric a soft, textured character and a gently draped appearance. The fabric lets diffused daylight into the room while softening glare and offering a reasonable degree of privacy, so the panels suit living rooms, bedrooms, and other spaces where you want a light, airy feel.

Sold as a set of two, each panel measures 52 inches wide by 84 inches long, so the pair spans about 104 inches across when hung side by side. Eight nickel grommets run along the top of every panel, and the header and bottom hem are sized for easy hanging. The grommets fit rods up to 1 1/4 inches in diameter.

The simple dove shade and understated pattern pair easily with a range of décor styles, from casual country to more traditional interiors. Care is straightforward: machine wash in cold water, use non-chlorine bleach only when needed, tumble dry on low, and iron with a warm iron as needed. The manufacturer offers a 30-day money-back return policy.
record.meta_description: Airy dove linen blend curtain panels with nickel grommets, set of 2 at 52 x 84 inches. Diffused light and privacy for living rooms and bedrooms.
record.seo_title: H.VERSAILTEX Dove Linen Blend Grommet Curtain Panels Set
